Name: Adjust Tree Seed Spread
Author: jenf1
Description:
[b][size=4]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/size][/b]

Adjust the chance that wild trees will spread their seed each day. Can choose any value from 0% for no spread or 100% for certain spread.

I will not be adding trees that do not spread by default (e.g Mystic Trees or Date Palm Trees from Cornucopia) as I feel that's too cheaty.

[size=5]Config Options:[/size]

Install the mod and run the game using SMAPI at least once in order to generate a config.json file.

All the following trees can be configured individually, in which you can adjust the percentage for a seed to spread. Default is 15%.

[list]
[*]Vanilla: Oak, Maple, Pine, Palm (Desert and Island), Mushroom, Mahogany, and Green Rain (types 1, 2, and 3)[/*]
[*]SVE: Birch and Fir[/*]
[*]Cornucopia: Sapodilla[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
- Copy [CP] Adjust Tree Seed Spread into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!
